data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native clean editorial photograph of a calm coastal breakfast built around the exact Glazery 13.5-ounce 3D shark ceramic mug in the attached reference. Preserve one ordinary usable mug with the exact product identity: glossy gray shark face wrapping the front, white back and loop handle, projecting pointed snout, one small fin on each side, tiny black dot eyes, narrow blue base rim, and a wide irregular red mouth opening edged with blunt white teeth. Fill the mug with dark coffee visible inside the red mouth without covering the teeth. Place it three-quarter front on a pale honed-limestone breakfast table, large enough to inspect, with one rumpled blue-and-white striped linen napkin, a small plate holding one slice of sourdough toast, and a simple stainless teaspoon. Use soft late-morning window light with restrained watery reflections on the wall, believable ceramic glaze and contact shadows, gentle 35mm editorial texture, slightly imperfect attainable styling, and generous breathing room. The visual joke must come only from the real shark-shaped mug in an elegant breakfast setting. Add no headline, caption, logo, price, badge, CTA, watermark, packaging, person, living animal, extra shark imagery, readable text, duplicate mug, extra fins, fantasy water, collage, UI, or ad-template composition. Keep the shark face, snout, fins, mouth, teeth, blue base, and handle fully consistent with the attached source image.
